data.text: Criteria 1 and 4 cannot be met by this task and are left unchecked: a release changes no behaviour, so there was no test to write first, and the core was untouched, so timing was not re-measured. Criterion 2: two full local runs each had exactly one failure, a different file each time, always 'Test timed out in 5000ms' — the machine sat at load average 20. Both files pass alone (prime 26/26, integration/merge 14/14), and CI on main is green in 59 s on the same code. Criterion 3: typecheck clean.
